Subject: Velora Health POC — quick post-call recap + next steps

Hi Alyssa / Tom — thanks again for your time today. Short recap from our side plus proposed next steps so we can move to kickoff next week: 

Key pain you confirmed
- High false positive rate (FP rate ~ 22%) on triage classifier when applied to real-world queries, leading to manual review backlog.
- Need < 5% FP for Tier 1 routing to trigger auto-responses; current latency targets for inference are 75-150ms p95.

Goals for the 4-week POC
1) Reduce FP to <= 8% on the pilot workload while keeping p95 latency <= 120ms.
2) Demonstrate consistent cost per 1k inference tokens under $8 (est.) using Redwood Optimize recommendations.
3) Provide a prompt/eval suite (50 labeled cases + 300 live-sampled prompts) and a regression dashboard for quality tracking.

Scope we agreed
- Model variant: open model A (quantized inference profile) + fallback to compact variant for heavy tails.
- Dataset: Velora will share a 2-week sample of anonymized triage logs (schema attached).
- Owners: Alyssa (Velora PM) and Mina (Redwood Solutions lead). Ben to lead procurement/contract. Marissa to run prompt/eval design and evaluation.

Immediate asks (by end of week)
- Alyssa: upload anonymized data sample (CSV) to the Drive folder and confirm SLA/security constraints.
- Tom: list of 3 production queries that must stay deterministic (we'll pin tests).
- Velora: point-of-contact for VPC/network if you want Private deployment for the POC.

Proposed kickoff (if data is ready): Monday 2027-06-21 10:00 PT — 45 minutes (technical owners + infra).

Attachments: velora-sample-data-schema.csv (schema only), poc-eval-prompt-set-v1.md (prompt skeleton)

I'll follow up with a detailed kickoff plan and timeline once I have the sample data.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Velora Health POC — kickoff plan, owners, and evaluation rubric

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the data drop — Alyssa, appreciate the upload. Below is the formal kickoff plan and owner matrix; this will be our single source of truth for week 0 prep.

Kickoff meeting (confirmed): Tue 2027-06-22 09:00 PT (45m) — calendar invite to follow.

POC timeline (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (Day 0-3): Data ingestion and schema validation (Velora provides sample; Redwood runs ingestion in hosted sandbox).
- Week 1: Baseline evaluation on existing model (metrics: FP rate, recall, p95 latency, token cost).
- Week 2: Prompt/eval sweep and quantization tuning (Marissa leads).
- Week 3: Canary rollout to pilot traffic + A/B evals (50:50).
- Week 4: Final evaluation, handoff recommendations and rollback plan.

Success metrics (primary)
- FP rate <= 8% on pilot dataset (measured on held-out 10k sample).
- p95 latency <= 120ms for 95% of requests under expected load (target load: 100qps burst 200qps).
- Quality regression: no more than 2% degradation on top-10 deterministic queries.

Evaluation assets (we will maintain in the Drive folder)
- Prompt set v1 (50 seed prompts + labeling guide) — Marissa to deliver by Thu 2027-06-24.
- Live sampling harness (to collect 300 production prompts) — Priyom to set up instrumentation.
- Regression dashboard (Redwood Console link will be shared during week 1).

Access & infra checklist
- Velora: share S3 presigned URL or Drive link to anonymized CSV and indicate if Private VPC is required.
- Redwood: will provision a sandbox project, create service account for Velora, and share IAM roles.
- Security: Ben will kick off SOC2 artifact share and DocuSign BAA if Velora needs it.

Owners
- Velora PM: Alyssa Chen (Velora) — data owner & acceptance sign-off.
- Velora Infra: Tom Hargreaves — networking / VPC.
- Redwood Solutions lead: Mina Haddad — POC owner & technical escalation.
- Redwood Eval lead: Marissa Cole — prompt design & monitoring.
- Redwood Sales Ops: Ben Carter — contracting and billing.

Risks & mitigations
- Large anonymized sample may contain PII remnants — Redwood will run a quick scan but Velora should confirm. If PII is found, we will pause ingestion and handle according to BAA terms.
- Tail latency spikes during large batched queries — we'll configure autoscaling and a compact fallback variant.

Next actions (owners + due dates)
1) Alyssa: confirm final upload and compliance note — due Thu 2027-06-17 EOD.
2) Marissa: draft prompt set v1 — due Thu 2027-06-24.
3) Priyom: instrumentation plan for live sampling — due Mon 2027-06-21.
4) Ben: send contract/BAA DocuSign to Alyssa — due Fri 2027-06-18.

Attachments in Drive: poc-eval-prompt-set-v1.md, velora-sample-data-schema.csv, velora-poc-compliance-checklist.pdf

I'll circulate the calendar invite and Redwood sandbox project info in a separate note.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff,
Mina
